about: Permit for a rehabilitation centre specialist to work with students inside a school.
note: Requirements read from the official ADEK service page on the checked date. Details are filled in after sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: The rehabilitation centre must hold a valid licence from its own government authority
The specialist must be a registered employee of the centre with a valid medical licence approved by that authority
channels: Online through the in-school specialist portal (inschoolspecialist.adek.gov.ae)
